units.title: 而、却、担心
units.intro: HSK 4, words 1–41, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: and; as well as; and so

ex.zh: 我要的不是茶，而是咖啡。
ex.p: wǒ yào de bù shì chá ér shì kā fēi
ex.en: What I want isn't tea, but coffee.

ex.zh: 这本书对我而言太贵了。
ex.p: zhè běn shū duì wǒ ér yán tài guì le
ex.en: This book is too expensive for me.

ex.zh: 他保证过会来却没有来。
ex.p: tā bǎo zhèng guò huì lái què méi yǒu lái
ex.en: He promised to come, but he didn't come.

ex.zh: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。
ex.p: nǐ huó zhe dàn shì què bù zhī dào wèi shén me huó zhe
ex.en: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.

ex.zh: 他一直很担心他的女儿。
ex.p: tā yī zhí hěn dān xīn tā de nǚ ér
ex.en: He's always worrying about his daughter.

ex.zh: 你不知道我有多担心啊。
ex.p: nǐ bù zhī dào wǒ yǒu duō dān xīn a
ex.en: You don't know how worried I am.

ex.zh: 他们四十分钟之后下课。
ex.p: tā men sì shí fēn zhōng zhī hòu xià kè
ex.en: They'll get out of class in forty minutes.

ex.zh: 布什继里根之后当上了总统。
ex.p: bù shén jì lǐ gēn zhī hòu dāng shǎng le zǒng tǒng
ex.en: Bush followed Reagan as president.

items.en: to understand; to realize; to find out

ex.zh: 我想要了解一些信息。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào liǎo jiě yī xiē xìn xī
ex.en: I'd like some information.

ex.zh: 他不是很了解日本。
ex.p: tā bù shì hěn liǎo jiě rì běn
ex.en: He doesn't know much about Japan.

ex.zh: 他们的计划我一无所知。
ex.p: tā men de jì huà wǒ yī wú suǒ zhī
ex.en: I am quite ignorant of their plan.

ex.zh: 如无必要我也不会打的。
ex.p: rú wú bì yào wǒ yě bù huì dá de
ex.en: I don't use taxis unless it's absolutely necessary.

ex.zh: 你可以选择任何你想要的。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn zé rèn hé nǐ xiǎng yào de
ex.en: You may choose whichever you want.

ex.zh: 你必须做出困难的选择。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū zuò chū kùn nan de xuǎn zé
ex.en: You have a difficult choice to make.

ex.zh: 你觉得对此该做什么？
ex.p: nǐ jué de duì cǐ gāi zuò shén me
ex.en: What do you think should be done about it?

ex.zh: 早知如此，就不应该借钱给他。
ex.p: zǎo zhī rú cǐ jiù bù yīng gāi jiè qián gěi tā
ex.en: You should have known better than to lend him money.

items.en: (particle equivalent to 啊 after a vowel, expressing surprise or doubt)

ex.zh: 你在学校学些什么呀？
ex.p: nǐ zài xué xiào xué xiē shén me ya
ex.en: What are you learning at school?

ex.zh: 你今天想去哪儿呀？
ex.p: nǐ jīn tiān xiǎng qù nǎr ya
ex.en: Where do you want to go today?

ex.zh: 你我之间需要来场谈话。
ex.p: nǐ wǒ zhī jiān xū yào lái cháng tán huà
ex.en: You and I need to have a talk.

ex.zh: 两者之间有显著的差别。
ex.p: liǎng zhě zhī jiān yǒu xiǎn zhù de chā bié
ex.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.

items.en: pertaining to; concerning; with regard to

ex.zh: 关于那个你有什么看法？
ex.p: guān yú nà gè nǐ yǒu shén me kàn fǎ
ex.en: What do you think about it?

ex.zh: 关于那件事你之前怎么想的？
ex.p: guān yú nà jiàn shì nǐ zhī qián zěn me xiǎng de
ex.en: How did you feel about that?

ex.zh: 他甚至没说再见就离开了家。
ex.p: tā shèn zhì méi shuō zài jiàn jiù lí kāi le jiā
ex.en: He left the house without so much as saying goodbye.

ex.zh: 他们甚至没办法写自己的名字。
ex.p: tā men shèn zhì méi bàn fǎ xiě zì jǐ de míng zi
ex.en: They didn't even know how to write their own names.

ex.zh: 你觉得我之前在做什么？
ex.p: nǐ jué de wǒ zhī qián zài zuò shén me
ex.en: What do you think I've been doing?

ex.zh: 我之前已经来过这里了。
ex.p: wǒ zhī qián yǐ jīng lái guò zhè lǐ le
ex.en: I've been here before.

ex.zh: 我再也无法相信任何人了。
ex.p: wǒ zài yě wú fǎ xiāng xìn rèn hé rén le
ex.en: I can't believe anyone anymore.

ex.zh: 我无法取代她做英语老师。
ex.p: wǒ wú fǎ qǔ dài tā zuò yīng yǔ lǎo shī
ex.en: I can't take the place of her as an English teacher.

items.en: regarding; as far as (sth) is concerned; with regard to

ex.zh: 这对于我来说没任何意义。
ex.p: zhè duì yú wǒ lái shuō méi rèn hé yì yì
ex.en: It doesn't make sense to me.

ex.zh: 为什么你对于这个有这样的想法？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ duì yú zhè gè yǒu zhè yàng de xiǎng fǎ
ex.en: Why should you think that?

items.en: to reside; to live; to dwell

ex.zh: 我同他们没有过共同之处。
ex.p: wǒ tóng tā men méi yǒu guò gòng tóng zhī chù
ex.en: I had nothing in common with them.

ex.zh: 我想这药会对您有好处的。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zhè yào huì duì nín yǒu hǎo chǔ de
ex.en: I think this medicine will do you good.

ex.zh: 你知道从火车站到市政府有多远？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào cóng huǒ chē zhàn dào shì zhèng fǔ yǒu duō yuǎn
ex.en: Do you know how far it is from the station to city hall?

ex.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
ex.p: zhèng fǔ yīng gāi jiā dà duì nóng yè de tóu zī
ex.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.

ex.zh: 我曾是世界上最幸福的男人。
ex.p: wǒ zēng shì shì jiè shǎng zuì xìng fú de nán rén
ex.en: I was the happiest man on earth.

ex.zh: 我曾经每周末都和朋友外出。
ex.p: wǒ céng jīng měi zhōu mò dōu hé péng you wài chū
ex.en: I used to go out with friends every weekend.

ex.zh: 他们已经换了系统。
ex.p: tā men yǐ jīng huàn le xì tǒng
ex.en: They've changed the system.

ex.zh: 系统运行起来了。
ex.p: xì tǒng yùn xíng qǐ lai le
ex.en: The system worked.

items.en: whether (or not); if; is or isn't

ex.zh: 我不知道我是否有时间做。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu yǒu shí jiān zuò
ex.en: I don't know if I have time to do it.

ex.zh: 让我知道我是否需要改变。
ex.p: ràng wǒ zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu xū yào gǎi biàn
ex.en: Let me know if I need to change.

ex.zh: 上天会帮助自力更生的人。
ex.p: shǎng tiān huì bāng zhù zì lì gēng shēng de rén
ex.en: God helps those who help themselves.

ex.zh: 他不知道他自己五音不全。
ex.p: tā bù zhī dào tā zì jǐ wǔ yīn bù quán
ex.en: He doesn't realise that he's tone deaf.

ex.zh: 我们研究这个问题吧。
ex.p: wǒ men yán jiū zhè gè wèn tí ba
ex.en: Let's get to work on that problem.

ex.zh: 他研究了十年。
ex.p: tā yán jiū le shí nián
ex.en: He studied for ten years.

items.en: to set; to fix; to determine

ex.zh: 他一定没有多考虑就说了。
ex.p: tā yī dìng méi yǒu duō kǎo lǜ jiù shuō le
ex.en: He must have said so without giving it much thought.

ex.zh: 他们在乡村安定了下来。
ex.p: tā men zài xiāng cūn ān dìng le xià lai
ex.en: They settled in the country.

items.en: to think over; to consider; consideration

ex.zh: 我们必须考虑到他很年轻。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū kǎo lǜ dào tā hěn nián qīng
ex.en: We must take into account the fact that he is young.

ex.zh: 我们本该考虑一下行程。
ex.p: wǒ men běn gāi kǎo lǜ yī xià xíng chéng
ex.en: We should've taken the schedule into consideration.

items.en: classifier indicating a small amount or small number greater than 1: some, a few

ex.zh: 别只顾着哭，做些什么啊！
ex.p: bié zhǐ gù zhe kū zuò xiē shén me a
ex.en: Don't just whine, do something!

ex.zh: 我有一些非常好的消息。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu yī xiē fēi cháng hǎo de xiāo xi
ex.en: I have some very good news.

items.en: to offer; to supply; to provide

ex.zh: 他们给图书馆提供了很多书。
ex.p: tā men gěi tú shū guǎn tí gōng le hěn duō shū
ex.en: They furnished the library with many books.

ex.zh: 奶牛为我们提供牛奶。
ex.p: nǎi niú wèi wǒ men tí gōng niú nǎi
ex.en: Cows provide us with milk.

ex.zh: 我不会唱那首歌的。
ex.p: wǒ bù huì chàng nà shǒu gē de
ex.en: I can't sing that song.

ex.zh: 我记得在哪儿听到过那首音乐。
ex.p: wǒ jì de zài nǎr tīng dào guò nà shǒu yīn yuè
ex.en: I remember hearing that music somewhere.

items.en: to treat (an illness); medical treatment; therapy

ex.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。
ex.p: yù fáng cuò shī bǐ zhēn zhèng de zhì liáo gēng yǒu xiào
ex.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.

ex.zh: 他们根据情报采取行动。
ex.p: tā men gēn jù qíng bào cǎi qǔ xíng dòng
ex.en: They acted on the information.

ex.zh: 不要根据封面来判断一本书。
ex.p: bù yào gēn jù fēng miàn lái pàn duàn yī běn shū
ex.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.

items.en: to obtain; to receive; to get

ex.zh: 医生坚持病人获得充分的休息。
ex.p: yī shēng jiān chí bìng rén huò dé chōng fèn de xiū xi
ex.en: The doctor insisted that the patient get plenty of rest.

ex.zh: 你对这件事有什么看法？
ex.p: nǐ duì zhè jiàn shì yǒu shén me kàn fǎ
ex.en: What do you think of it?

ex.zh: 我无法相信自己的眼睛。
ex.p: wǒ wú fǎ xiāng xìn zì jǐ de yǎn jing
ex.en: I can't believe my eyes.

ex.zh: 感觉这不会有个好结局。
ex.p: gǎn jué zhè bù huì yǒu gè hǎo jié jú
ex.en: I feel like this isn't going to end well.

ex.zh: 我改了一下我的网站的布局。
ex.p: wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ de wǎng zhàn de bù jú
ex.en: I've changed my website's layout.

ex.zh: 他正在思考他未来的生活。
ex.p: tā zhèng zài sī kǎo tā wèi lái de shēng huó
ex.en: He was meditating on his future life.

ex.zh: 孩子是我们的未来。
ex.p: hái zi shì wǒ men de wèi lái
ex.en: Children are our future.

ex.zh: 在我看来，这个问题很难解决。
ex.p: zài wǒ kàn lai zhè gè wèn tí hěn nán jiě jué
ex.en: In my opinion, it would be difficult to solve this problem.

ex.zh: 看来她已经收到了钱。
ex.p: kàn lai tā yǐ jīng shōu dào le qián
ex.en: It seemed that she had already received the money.

ex.zh: 这个问题有多严重？
ex.p: zhè gè wèn tí yǒu duō yán zhòng
ex.en: How serious is the problem?

ex.zh: 这是很严重的病。
ex.p: zhè shì hěn yán zhòng de bìng
ex.en: It's a very serious illness.

items.en: to comprise; to include; to involve

ex.zh: 包括早饭吗？
ex.p: bāo kuò zǎo fàn ma
ex.en: Is breakfast included?

ex.zh: 法律之前人人平等。
ex.p: fǎ lǜ zhī qián rén rén píng děng
ex.en: All men are equal under the law.

ex.zh: 法律很清楚。
ex.p: fǎ lǜ hěn qīng chu
ex.en: The law is quite clear.

ex.zh: 你做了一项完美的工作。
ex.p: nǐ zuò le yī xiàng wán měi de gōng zuò
ex.en: You've done a perfect job.

ex.zh: 你的项目进展得怎么样？
ex.p: nǐ de xiàng mù jìn zhǎn de zěn me yàng
ex.en: How's your project going?

ex.zh: 你到底为什么要这么做？
ex.p: nǐ dào dǐ wèi shén me yào zhè me zuò
ex.en: Why exactly did you need to do that?

ex.zh: 你到底在我房间里干什么？
ex.p: nǐ dào dǐ zài wǒ fáng jiān lǐ gàn shén me
ex.en: What on earth are you doing in my room?

units.title: 不管、解释、历史
units.intro: HSK 4, words 42–82, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: not to be concerned; regardless of; no matter

ex.zh: 不管问了什么，她都能回答。
ex.p: bù guǎn wèn le shén me tā dōu néng huí dá
ex.en: She was able to answer whatever was asked.

ex.zh: 不管怎样，我们所有人都将死。
ex.p: bù guǎn zěn yàng wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén dōu jiāng sǐ
ex.en: We're all going to die anyway.

ex.zh: 他解释了句子的字面意思。
ex.p: tā jiě shì le jù zi de zì miàn yì si
ex.en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentence.

ex.zh: 他解释事故是怎么发生的。
ex.p: tā jiě shì shì gù shì zěn me fā shēng de
ex.en: He explained how the accident came about.

ex.zh: 历史不是他的主修课。
ex.p: lì shǐ bù shì tā de zhǔ xiū kè
ex.en: History is not his major subject.

ex.zh: 他喜欢地理和历史。
ex.p: tā xǐ huan dì lǐ hé lì shǐ
ex.en: He likes geography and history.

items.en: one of (sth); one out of a multitude; one (third, quarter, percent etc)

ex.zh: 你是我最好的朋友之一。
ex.p: nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you zhī yī
ex.en: You're one of my best friends.

ex.zh: 这只是我们发现的东西之一。
ex.p: zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men fā xiàn de dōng xī zhī yī
ex.en: This is only one of the things we found.

ex.zh: 他们一起为这个项目工作过。
ex.p: tā men yī qǐ wèi zhè gè xiàng mù gōng zuò guò
ex.en: They worked jointly on this project.

ex.zh: 这是我最喜欢的项目。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de xiàng mù
ex.en: This is my favorite project.

ex.zh: 我当然希望这是一个梦。
ex.p: wǒ dāng rán xī wàng zhè shì yī gè mèng
ex.en: I sure hope this is a dream.

ex.zh: 她梦见她是一个公主。
ex.p: tā mèng jiàn tā shì yī gè gōng zhǔ
ex.en: She dreamed that she was a princess.

ex.zh: 我觉得这本书很简单。
ex.p: wǒ jué de zhè běn shū hěn jiǎn dān
ex.en: I think this book is easy.

ex.zh: 比我想象中的更简单。
ex.p: bǐ wǒ xiǎng xiàng zhōng de gēng jiǎn dān
ex.en: That was easier than I thought it would be.

ex.zh: 她对她的孩子非常生气。
ex.p: tā duì tā de hái zi fēi cháng shēng qì
ex.en: She got very angry with her children.

ex.zh: 我们学校离公园非常近。
ex.p: wǒ men xué xiào chī gōng yuán fēi cháng jìn
ex.en: Our school is very close to the park.

ex.zh: 总统在电视上对国民讲话。
ex.p: zǒng tǒng zài diàn shì shǎng duì guó mín jiǎng huà
ex.en: The President spoke to the nation on TV.

ex.zh: 他后来写信给总统。
ex.p: tā hòu lái xiě xìn gěi zǒng tǒng
ex.en: Later he wrote to the president.

ex.zh: 交通事故的数量似乎在增长。
ex.p: jiāo tōng shì gù de shù liàng sì hū zài zēng zhǎng
ex.en: The number of traffic accidents seems to be on the increase.

ex.zh: 其中一些似乎太难了。
ex.p: qí zhōng yī xiē sì hū tài nán le
ex.en: Some of them seem to be too difficult.

ex.zh: 为什么我们应该要帮助？
ex.p: wèi shén me wǒ men yīng gāi yào bāng zhù
ex.en: Why should we help?

ex.zh: 他本应该成为一个律师。
ex.p: tā běn yīng gāi chéng wéi yī gè lǜ shī
ex.en: He should have been a lawyer.

ex.zh: 你们几乎什么都没有吃。
ex.p: nǐ men jī hū shén me dōu méi yǒu chī
ex.en: You hardly ate anything.

ex.zh: 我几乎每天都见到那条狗。
ex.p: wǒ jī hū měi tiān dōu jiàn dào nà tiáo gǒu
ex.en: I see that dog almost every day.

ex.zh: 这个球是那个男孩的宝贝。
ex.p: zhè gè qiú shì nà gè nán hái de bǎo bèi
ex.en: This ball is that boy's treasure.

ex.zh: 他是家里的宝贝。
ex.p: tā shì jiā lǐ de bǎo bèi
ex.en: He is the baby of the family.

ex.zh: 教堂在村子的中心位置。
ex.p: jiào táng zài cūn zǐ de zhōng xīn wèi zhi
ex.en: The church is in the middle of the village.

ex.zh: 我们会给你留个位置。
ex.p: wǒ men huì gěi nǐ liú gè wèi zhi
ex.en: We'll save a seat for you.

ex.zh: 他在这方面不是很严格。
ex.p: tā zài zhè fāng miàn bù shì hěn yán gé
ex.en: He's not very strict about this.

ex.zh: 他够大方，借了我一点钱。
ex.p: tā gòu dà fāng jiè le wǒ yī diǎn qián
ex.en: He was kind enough to lend me some money.

ex.zh: 我在银行附近碰见老朋友。
ex.p: wǒ zài yín háng fù jìn pèng jiàn lǎo péng you
ex.en: I ran across an old friend near the bank.

ex.zh: 我家附近有个漂亮的公园。
ex.p: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu gè piào liang de gōng yuán
ex.en: There is a beautiful park near my home.

ex.zh: 参与者大部分是女性。
ex.p: cān yù zhě dà bù fen shì nǚ xìng
ex.en: The participants were for the most part women.

ex.zh: 我们正参与。
ex.p: wǒ men zhēng cān yù
ex.en: We're involved.

ex.zh: 他们不是在打架，而是在排练戏剧。
ex.p: tā men bù shì zài dǎ jià ér shì zài pái liàn xì jù
ex.en: They aren't quarreling, but are rehearsing a play.

ex.zh: 我要的不是茶，而是咖啡。
ex.p: wǒ yào de bù shì chá ér shì kā fēi
ex.en: What I want isn't tea, but coffee.

ex.zh: 他们要求马上把国王处死。
ex.p: tā men yāo qiú mǎ shàng bǎ guó wáng chù sǐ
ex.en: They demanded the king be put to death at once.

ex.zh: 海王星是太阳系第八个行星。
ex.p: hǎi wáng xīng shì tài yang xì dì bā gè xíng xīng
ex.en: Neptune is the eighth planet of the solar system.

ex.zh: 我需要做手术吗？
ex.p: wǒ xū yào zuò shǒu shù ma
ex.en: Do I need surgery?

ex.zh: 该手术无痛。
ex.p: gāi shǒu shù wú tòng
ex.en: The procedure is painless.

items.en: to become a member; to join; to mix into

ex.zh: 我们很高兴你加入了我们班。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng nǐ jiā rù le wǒ men bān
ex.en: We are glad to have you in our class.

ex.zh: 来加入我们吧。
ex.p: lái jiā rù wǒ men ba
ex.en: Join us.

items.en: brothers; younger brother; I, me (humble term used by men in public speech)

ex.zh: 他们错把他当成他的兄弟。
ex.p: tā men cuò bǎ tā dàng chéng tā de xiōng dì
ex.en: They mistook him for his brother.

ex.zh: 他有一个兄弟和两个姐妹。
ex.p: tā yǒu yī gè xiōng dì hé liǎng gè jiě mèi
ex.en: He has a brother and two sisters.

items.en: to meet; to run into; to come across

ex.zh: 我在回家的路上遇到了他。
ex.p: wǒ zài huí jiā de lù shang yù dào le tā
ex.en: I met him on my way home.

ex.zh: 没多久，我们又碰巧遇到了。
ex.p: méi duō jiǔ wǒ men yòu pèng qiǎo yù dào le
ex.en: It was not long before we met again by chance.

items.en: wheel; disk; ring; steamship; to take turns; to rotate

ex.zh: 下次该轮到我开车了。
ex.p: xià cì gāi lún dào wǒ kāi chē le
ex.en: It's my turn to drive next.

ex.zh: 轮到他时，我们故意跳过了他。
ex.p: lún dào tā shí wǒ men gù yì tiào guò le tā
ex.en: We skipped his turn on purpose.

ex.zh: 我不知道他的地址。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào tā de dì zhǐ
ex.en: I don't know his address.

ex.zh: 我能找到他的地址。
ex.p: wǒ néng zhǎo dào tā de dì zhǐ
ex.en: I was able to find out his address.

items.en: no matter what or how; regardless of whether...

ex.zh: 无论如何，都不关你的事。
ex.p: wú lùn rú hé dōu bù guān nǐ de shì
ex.en: In any case, it's none of your business.

ex.zh: 无论我做什么，你都不高兴。
ex.p: wú lùn wǒ zuò shén me nǐ dōu bù gāo xìng
ex.en: You won't be happy no matter what I do.

items.en: to cast; to send; to throw oneself (into the river etc)

ex.zh: 外国投资者从美国收回他们的钱。
ex.p: wài guó tóu zī zhě cóng měi guó shōu huí tā men de qián
ex.en: Foreign investors withdrew their money from America.

ex.zh: 我在这项计划上投入了所有精力。
ex.p: wǒ zài zhè xiàng jì huà shǎng tóu rù le suǒ yǒu jīng lì
ex.en: I've put all of my energy into this plan.

items.en: thereupon; as a result; consequently; thus; hence

ex.zh: 我根本不需要这个。
ex.p: wǒ gēn běn bù xū yào zhè gè
ex.en: I don't need this at all.

ex.zh: 这根本不是确定的。
ex.p: zhè gēn běn bù shì què dìng de
ex.en: It is by no means certain.

ex.zh: 正好那个时候，公交车停下来了。
ex.p: zhèng hǎo nà gè shí hou gōng jiāo chē tíng xià lái le
ex.en: Just then, the bus stopped.

ex.zh: 他停下来好穿鞋。
ex.p: tā tíng xià lái hǎo chuān xié
ex.en: He stopped to put on his shoes.

ex.zh: 他失信了，这让他妻子生气。
ex.p: tā shī xìn le zhè ràng tā qī zǐ shēng qì
ex.en: He broke his word, which made his wife angry.

ex.zh: 他让他的妻子补好衬衫。
ex.p: tā ràng tā de qī zǐ bǔ hǎo chèn shān
ex.en: He got his wife to mend his shirt.

ex.zh: 我父亲爱世上的每一个人。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn ài shì shǎng de měi yī gè rén
ex.en: My father loves everyone in the world.

items.en: to give rise to; to lead to; to cause; to arouse

ex.zh: 汤姆只是想引起你的注意。
ex.p: tāng mǔ zhǐ shì xiǎng yǐn qǐ nǐ de zhù yì
ex.en: Tom just wants your attention.

ex.zh: 你们共住一个房间吗？
ex.p: nǐ men gòng zhù yī gè fáng jiān ma
ex.en: Do you share a room?

ex.zh: 你共住一个房间吗？
ex.p: nǐ gòng zhù yī gè fáng jiān ma
ex.en: Do you share a room?

ex.zh: 她或许知道我们在这儿。
ex.p: tā huò xǔ zhī dào wǒ men zài zhèr
ex.en: She might know that we are here.

ex.zh: 我或许可以修好它。
ex.p: wǒ huò xǔ kě yǐ xiū hǎo tā
ex.en: I might be able to fix that.

ex.zh: 你投资多少？
ex.p: nǐ tóu zī duō shǎo
ex.en: How much do you have invested?

ex.zh: 外国投资者从美国收回他们的钱。
ex.p: wài guó tóu zī zhě cóng měi guó shōu huí tā men de qián
ex.en: Foreign investors withdrew their money from America.

items.en: to hold; to carry (in one's arms); to hug

ex.zh: 我一把孩子抱在手里，他就开始哭了。
ex.p: wǒ yī bǎ hái zi bào zài shǒu lǐ tā jiù kāi shǐ kū le
ex.en: The moment I held the baby in my arms, it began to cry.

ex.zh: 我想要个抱抱。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào gè bào bào
ex.en: I want a hug.

ex.zh: 我有志成为一名律师。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu zhì chéng wéi yī míng lǜ shī
ex.en: I intend to become a lawyer.

ex.zh: 他儿子想当律师。
ex.p: tā ér zi xiǎng dāng lǜ shī
ex.en: His son wants to be a lawyer.

items.en: to lead to; to create; to cause

ex.zh: 那事故是他的粗心导致的。
ex.p: nà shì gù shì tā de cū xīn dǎo zhì de
ex.en: That accident was due to his carelessness.

ex.zh: 道路结冰导致了很多起事故。
ex.p: dào lù jié bīng dǎo zhì le hěn duō qǐ shì gù
ex.en: Many accidents resulted from the icy conditions of the road.

units.title: 战争、机构、反
units.intro: HSK 4, words 83–123, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.zh: 为什么这世界上还有战争？
ex.p: wèi shén me zhè shì jiè shǎng hái yǒu zhàn zhēng
ex.en: Why are there still wars in the world?

ex.zh: 我父母那一代经历过战争。
ex.p: wǒ fù mǔ nà yī dài jīng lì guò zhàn zhēng
ex.en: My parents' generation went through the war.

items.en: contrary; in reverse; inside out or upside down

ex.zh: 他做的和我要求的相反。
ex.p: tā zuò de hé wǒ yāo qiú de xiāng fǎn
ex.en: He did the reverse of what I asked.

ex.zh: 他反对妻子在外工作。
ex.p: tā fǎn duì qī zǐ zài wài gōng zuò
ex.en: He objected to his wife working outside.

ex.zh: 你不再能伤害到我了。
ex.p: nǐ bù zài néng shāng hài dào wǒ le
ex.en: You can no longer hurt me.

ex.zh: 他们不会伤害我们。
ex.p: tā men bù huì shāng hài wǒ men
ex.en: They won't hurt us.

items.en: space; room; (fig.) scope; leeway; (astronomy) outer space

ex.zh: 行与行之间多留些空间。
ex.p: xíng yú xíng zhī jiān duō liú xiē kōng jiān
ex.en: Leave more space between the lines.

items.en: (of water) to dash against; to mix with water; to infuse

ex.zh: 他穿着衣服冲进房间。
ex.p: tā chuān zhuó yī fu chōng jìn fáng jiān
ex.en: He rushed into the room with his coat on.

ex.zh: 每个人都向我们冲来。
ex.p: měi gè rén dōu xiàng wǒ men chōng lái
ex.en: Everybody rushed towards us.

items.en: to look forward to; to await; expectation

ex.zh: 我期待很快就能收到你的信。
ex.p: wǒ qī dài hěn kuài jiù néng shōu dào nǐ de xìn
ex.en: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

ex.zh: 它正是我所期待的。
ex.p: tā zhèng shì wǒ suǒ qī dài de
ex.en: It's just what I expected.

ex.zh: 我受不了那种政治家。
ex.p: wǒ shòu bù liǎo nà zhǒng zhèng zhì jiā
ex.en: I can't stand that kind of politician.

ex.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou kǒu wù duì zhèng zhì jiā lái shuō shì zhì mìng de
ex.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.

items.en: to admit; to concede; to recognize

ex.zh: 他承认了自己的错误。
ex.p: tā chéng rèn le zì jǐ de cuò wù
ex.en: He admitted his mistakes.

ex.zh: 你能承认你错了是很伟大的。
ex.p: nǐ néng chéng rèn nǐ cuò le shì hěn wěi dà de
ex.en: It's very big of you to admit you're wrong.

ex.zh: 我看见天上有奇怪的东西。
ex.p: wǒ kàn jiàn tiān shàng yǒu qí guài de dōng xī
ex.en: I saw something strange in the sky.

ex.zh: 从山上走来一只巨大的怪物。
ex.p: cóng shān shǎng zǒu lái yī zhǐ jù dà de guài wu
ex.en: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.

ex.zh: 你想看哪种类型的电影？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng kàn nǎ zhǒng lèi xíng de diàn yǐng
ex.en: What kind of movie do you want to watch?

ex.zh: 他们是典型的年轻人。
ex.p: tā men shì diǎn xíng de nián qīng rén
ex.en: They're typical youngsters.

ex.zh: 我们必须保持家庭传统。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū bǎo chí jiā tíng chuán tǒng
ex.en: We must keep up the family traditions.

ex.zh: 他们传统的生活方式不再存在。
ex.p: tā men chuán tǒng de shēng huó fāng shì bù zài cún zài
ex.en: Their traditional life style no longer exists.

ex.zh: 没有任何干净的盘子。
ex.p: méi yǒu rèn hé gān jìng de pán zi
ex.en: There are no clean plates.

ex.zh: 警察盘问你了吗？
ex.p: jǐng chá pán wèn nǐ le ma
ex.en: Did the police ever question you?

ex.zh: 他会是我妹妹的好丈夫的。
ex.p: tā huì shì wǒ mèi mei de hǎo zhàng fu de
ex.en: He will be a good husband to my sister.

ex.zh: 她取笑了她的丈夫。
ex.p: tā qǔ xiào le tā de zhàng fu
ex.en: She made fun of her husband.

items.en: to turn over; to flip over; to overturn

ex.zh: 把这里翻个底朝天！
ex.p: bǎ zhè lǐ fān gè de cháo tiān
ex.en: Leave no stone unturned.

ex.zh: 她翻了一页书。
ex.p: tā fān le yī xié shū
ex.en: She turned a page of her book.

items.en: unexpectedly; to one's surprise; in spite of everything

ex.zh: 我很惊讶你竟然那么天真。
ex.p: wǒ hěn jīng yà nǐ jìng rán nà me tiān zhēn
ex.en: I'm surprised you're so naive.

ex.zh: 我不知道他来这里的确切时间。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào tā lái zhè lǐ dí què qiē shí jiān
ex.en: I don't know for certain when he will come.

ex.zh: 电视的确有一些缺点。
ex.p: diàn shì dí què yǒu yī xiē quē diǎn
ex.en: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.

ex.zh: 他的工资是我的两倍。
ex.p: tā de gōng zī shì wǒ de liǎng bèi
ex.en: He earns twice as much as me.

ex.zh: 这条河比那条长三倍。
ex.p: zhè tiáo hé bǐ nà tiáo cháng sān bèi
ex.en: This river is three times longer than that one.

items.en: to wake up; to be awake; to become aware

ex.zh: 今天早晨被头给疼醒了。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo chén bèi tóu gěi téng xǐng le
ex.en: I woke up with a headache this morning.

ex.zh: 我母亲昨天很晚还醒着。
ex.p: wǒ mǔ qīn zuó tiān hěn wǎn hái xǐng zhe
ex.en: My mother was up late last night.

items.en: identity; role; capacity (as in "in his capacity as a ..." 以…份)

ex.zh: 你想保持匿名身份。
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng bǎo chí nì míng shēn fèn
ex.en: You want to remain anonymous.

ex.zh: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。
ex.p: wǒ men de jiū jí mù biāo shì shù lì shì jiè hé píng
ex.en: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.

ex.zh: 试着用积极的态度去面对任何事情。
ex.p: shì zhe yòng jī jí de tài du qù miàn duì rèn hé shì qing
ex.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.

ex.zh: 世上没有免费的午餐。
ex.p: shì shǎng méi yǒu miǎn fèi de wǔ cān
ex.en: There's no such thing as a free lunch.

ex.zh: 天下没有免费的午餐。
ex.p: tiān xià méi yǒu miǎn fèi de wǔ cān
ex.en: There's no such thing as a free lunch.

items.en: mahjong tile; playing card; game pieces

ex.zh: “我想打牌。”“我也是。”
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng dǎ pái wǒ yě shì
ex.en: "I feel like playing cards." "So do I."

ex.zh: 打牌很有意思。
ex.p: dǎ pái hěn yǒu yì si
ex.en: Playing cards is very interesting.

items.en: two (colloquial equivalent of 两个); both; some

ex.zh: 他们俩又在吵架了。
ex.p: tā men liǎ yòu zài chǎo jià le
ex.en: Those two are arguing again.

ex.zh: 他们俩都在房间里。
ex.p: tā men liǎ dōu zài fáng jiān lǐ
ex.en: They are both in the room.

ex.zh: 这个国家的主要产品之一是咖啡。
ex.p: zhè gè guó jiā de zhǔ yào chǎn pǐn zhī yī shì kā fēi
ex.en: One of the main products of this country is coffee.

ex.zh: 这些产品的品质是一样的。
ex.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn de pǐn zhì shì yī yàng de
ex.en: The quality of these products is the same.

items.en: to test (machinery etc); to test (a person's skill in a particular area); a test

ex.zh: 我觉得这个测试很难。
ex.p: wǒ jué de zhè gè cè shì hěn nán
ex.en: I found the test difficult.

ex.zh: 我的意见是，你该再次参加测试。
ex.p: wǒ de yì jiàn shì nǐ gāi zài cì cān jiā cè shì
ex.en: I think you should take the test again.

items.en: to leave out; to be missing; to leave behind or forget to bring

ex.zh: 太阳从东边升起，西边落下。
ex.p: tài yang cóng dōng bian shēng qǐ xī biān luò xià
ex.en: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

ex.zh: 没有什么落下的吧？
ex.p: méi yǒu shén me luò xià de ba
ex.en: Do you have everything?

ex.zh: 他成为了著名的歌手。
ex.p: tā chéng wéi le zhù míng de gē shǒu
ex.en: He became a famous singer.

ex.zh: 她是一个著名的歌手。
ex.p: tā shì yī gè zhù míng de gē shǒu
ex.en: She is a famous singer.

ex.zh: 他们非常兴奋。
ex.p: tā men fēi cháng xīng fèn

ex.zh: 我对这些故事很感兴趣。

ex.zh: 那不是明摆着的吗？
ex.p: nà bù shì míng bǎi zhe de ma

ex.zh: 大好的前途摆在他面前。
ex.p: dà hǎo de qián tú bǎi zài tā miàn qián
ex.en: A brilliant future lay before him.

ex.zh: 你最喜欢的颜色是什么？
ex.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de yán sè shì shén me
ex.en: What's your favorite color?

ex.zh: 她今天穿著白色的衣服。
ex.p: tā jīn tiān chuān zhù bái sè de yī fu
ex.en: She is wearing a white dress today.

items.en: to be in; to lie in; to consist in
to display; to exhibit; to bring out implicit or innate qualities

ex.zh: 发挥您的想象力。
ex.p: fā huī nín de xiǎng xiàng lì
ex.en: Use your imagination.

items.en: in keeping with; in accordance with; tallying with

ex.zh: 我不认识符合条件的人。
ex.p: wǒ bù rèn shi fú hé tiáo jiàn de rén
ex.en: I don't know anyone who matches that description.

items.en: to weave; to plait; to organize

ex.zh: 他编造了一个借口。
ex.p: tā biān zào le yī gè jiè kǒu
ex.en: He thought up an excuse.

ex.zh: 我编译这个程序有些困难。
ex.p: wǒ biān yì zhè gè chéng xù yǒu xiē kùn nan
ex.en: I'm having some problems compiling this software.

ex.zh: 你必须独立完成。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū dú lì wán chéng
ex.en: You have to do it by yourself.

ex.zh: 你认为他是自己独立完成这份工的吗？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi tā shì zì jǐ dú lì wán chéng zhè fèn gōng de ma
ex.en: Do you think he did the job on his own?

ex.zh: 男孩躺着听收音机。
ex.p: nán hái tǎng zhe yǐn shōu yīn jī
ex.en: The boy lay listening to the radio.

items.en: to interview; to gather news; to hunt for and collect
to target; to focus on; to be aimed at or against

ex.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi jìn zhǐ zhēn duì ér tóng de guǎng gào
ex.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.

items.en: on the eve of; to be about to; to be on the verge of

ex.zh: 这场谈论即将对污染问题展开讨论。
ex.p: zhè cháng tán lùn jí jiāng duì wū rǎn wèn tí zhǎn kāi tǎo lùn
ex.en: The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.

ex.zh: 她给客人看了她的宝宝。
ex.p: tā gěi kè rén kàn le tā de bǎo bao
ex.en: She showed the visitor her baby.

ex.zh: 我家宝宝还不会说话。
ex.p: wǒ jiā bǎo bao hái bù huì shuō huà
ex.en: Our baby can't talk yet.

ex.zh: 学生们无法给出一个答案。
ex.p: xué sheng men wú fǎ gěi chū yī gè dá àn
ex.en: The students could not give an answer.

ex.zh: 这个问题似乎没有答案。
ex.p: zhè gè wèn tí sì hū méi yǒu dá àn
ex.en: There seemed to be no answer to the problem.

ex.zh: 你能帮我说明一下规则吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ shuō míng yī xià guī zé ma
ex.en: Will you explain the rule to me?

ex.zh: 我不喜欢学习不规则动词。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan xué xí bù guī zé dòng cí
ex.en: I don't like learning irregular verbs.

items.en: to move emotionally; to stir up (emotions); to excite

ex.zh: 我快要激动得说不出话来了。
ex.p: wǒ kuài yào jī dòng de shuō bù chū huà lái le
ex.en: I'm getting choked up.

ex.zh: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。
ex.p: tài kōng pǎo bù shì lì shǐ shǎng jī dòng rén xīn de shí kè
ex.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.

ex.zh: 你依然和父母住一起吗？
ex.p: nǐ yī rán hé fù mǔ zhù yī qǐ ma
ex.en: Are you still living with your parents?

ex.zh: 她现在依然依靠父母生活。
ex.p: tā xiàn zài yī rán yī kào fù mǔ shēng huó
ex.en: She's still dependent on her parents.

items.en: to rub; to scratch; to towel; to wipe with a towel

ex.zh: 我要他擦亮我的皮鞋。
ex.p: wǒ yào tā cā liàng wǒ de pí xié
ex.en: I got him to polish my shoes.

ex.zh: 擦擦你的眼睛。
ex.p: cā cā nǐ de yǎn jing
ex.en: Wipe your eyes.

ex.zh: 他的演讲让我很无聊。
ex.p: tā de yǎn jiǎng ràng wǒ hěn wú liáo
ex.en: I was bored with his speech.

ex.zh: 实际上，我非常无聊。
ex.p: shí jì shàng wǒ fēi cháng wú liáo
ex.en: Actually, it was pretty boring.

ex.zh: 我和他们意见一致。
ex.p: wǒ hé tā men yì jiàn yī zhì
ex.en: I think the same as they do.

ex.zh: 选举一致通过了。
ex.p: xuǎn jǔ yī zhì tōng guò le
ex.en: The vote is unanimous.

ex.zh: 我的宝宝开始哭了，他想要吃奶。
ex.p: wǒ de bǎo bao kāi shǐ kū le tā xiǎng yào chī nǎi
ex.en: My baby began crying, asking for milk.

ex.zh: 宝宝对我笑了。
ex.p: bǎo bao duì wǒ xiào le
ex.en: The baby smiled at me.

ex.zh: 你今年做的最刺激的事是什么？
ex.p: nǐ jīn nián zuò de zuì cì jī de shì shì shén me
ex.en: What's the most exciting thing you've done this year?

items.en: to stick; to paste; to post (e.g. on a blog)

ex.zh: 我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。
ex.p: wǒ wàng jì zài xìn fēng shǎng tiē yóu piào le
ex.en: I forgot to put a stamp on the envelope.

ex.zh: 别忘了在你的信上贴张邮票。
ex.p: bié wàng le zài nǐ de xìn shǎng tiē zhāng yóu piào
ex.en: Don't forget to put a stamp on your letter.

ex.zh: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。
ex.p: zhè jī nián kē xué qǔ dé le xiǎn zhù de jìn bù
ex.en: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.

ex.zh: 两者之间有显著的差别。
ex.p: liǎng zhě zhī jiān yǒu xiǎn zhù de chā bié
ex.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.

items.en: as quickly as possible; as soon as possible

ex.zh: 我会尽快给你打电话的。
ex.p: wǒ huì jǐn kuài gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de
ex.en: I'll call you as soon as I can.

ex.zh: 我会尽快处理这问题。
ex.p: wǒ huì jǐn kuài chǔ lǐ zhè wèn tí
ex.en: I'll deal with this problem as soon as I can.

ex.zh: 将你需要的药物写在这张纸上。
ex.p: jiāng nǐ xū yào de yào wù xiě zài zhè zhāng zhǐ shǎng
ex.en: Write down the medicine you need on this piece of paper.

ex.zh: 药物的作用还不确定。
ex.p: yào wù de zuò yòng hái bù què dìng
ex.en: Whether the medicine will work or not is uncertain.

ex.zh: 轻轻地移动。
ex.p: qīng qīng de yí dòng
ex.en: Move quietly.

items.en: to sell; to market; sales (representative, agreement etc)

ex.zh: 谁负责销售部门？
ex.p: shéi fù zé xiāo shòu bù mén
ex.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?

ex.zh: 我能闻到他呼吸中的酒精味。
ex.p: wǒ néng wén dào tā hū xī zhōng de jiǔ jīng wèi
ex.en: I could smell the alcohol on his breath.

ex.zh: 她止住了呼吸。
ex.p: tā zhǐ zhù le hū xī
ex.en: She held her breath.

ex.zh: 出去之前确认一下所有的灯都关了。
ex.p: chū qù zhī qián què rèn yī xià suǒ yǒu de dēng dōu guān le
ex.en: Make sure to turn off all the lights before going out.

ex.zh: 客服很出色。
ex.p: kè fú hěn chū sè
ex.en: The customer service is excellent.

ex.zh: 他是位出色的作家。
ex.p: tā shì wèi chū sè de zuò jiā
ex.en: He is a good writer.

items.en: ice; to chill sth; (of an object or substance) to feel cold

ex.zh: 冰箱里什么也没有了。
ex.p: bīng xiāng lǐ shén me yě méi yǒu le
ex.en: There's nothing left in the fridge.

ex.zh: 天冷得足以让湖结冰。
ex.p: tiān lěng de zú yǐ ràng hú jié bīng
ex.en: The weather was so cold that the lake froze over.

items.en: (of a plant) to produce (fruit or seeds)

ex.zh: 他和一个美国女人结婚了。
ex.p: tā hé yī gè měi guó nǚ rén jié hūn le
ex.en: He is married to an American lady.

ex.zh: 我想跟你这样的人结婚。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ zhè yàng de rén jié hūn
ex.en: I'd like to get married to someone like you.

ex.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

items.en: disappointed; to lose hope; to despair

ex.p: wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù huì ràng nǐ shī wàng
ex.en: I would never let you down.

ex.zh: 我的母亲对我的失败感到失望。
ex.p: wǒ de mǔ qīn duì wǒ de shī bài gǎn dào shī wàng
ex.en: My mother was disappointed by my failure.

ex.p: nín de shǒu jī hào mǎ shì duō shǎo

ex.zh: 那是可避免的。
ex.p: nà shì kě bì miǎn de

ex.p: wǒ men cè liáng le zhè tiáo hé de shēn dù

ex.p: tā men yī zhí nào xiào hua

ex.zh: 我们晚饭后吃新鲜水果。
ex.p: wǒ men wǎn fàn hòu chī xīn xiān shuǐ guǒ
ex.en: We ate fresh fruit after dinner.

ex.zh: 我想要一些新鲜的鸡蛋。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī xiē xīn xiān de jī dàn
ex.en: I want some fresh eggs.

ex.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。
ex.p: zì wǒ huái yí shì cōng ming de dì yī biāo zhì
ex.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.

items.en: (literary) to catch; to capture; (literary) to get; to obtain; to win

ex.zh: 没有挑战就没有收获。
ex.p: méi yǒu tiǎo zhàn jiù méi yǒu shōu huò
ex.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

items.en: to conduct; to command; to direct

ex.zh: 我恐怕不是个很好的伙伴。
ex.p: wǒ kǒng pà bù shì gè hěn hǎo de huǒ bàn
ex.en: I'm afraid I wouldn't be very good company.

ex.zh: 这两个男人是生意上的合作伙伴。
ex.p: zhè liǎng gè nán rén shì shēng yì shǎng de hé zuò huǒ bàn
ex.en: The two men were business partners.

items.en: to feel with the hand; to touch; to stroke

ex.zh: 他在口袋里摸着找他的钱包。
ex.p: tā zài kǒu dài lǐ mō zhe zhǎo tā de qián bāo
ex.en: He felt in his pocket for his wallet.

ex.zh: 来吧，摸一下。
ex.p: lái ba mō yī xià
ex.en: Come on, touch it.

ex.zh: 这几天我脑袋里的事情太多了。
ex.p: zhè jī tiān wǒ nǎo dai lǐ de shì qing tài duō le
ex.en: I have too many things on my mind these days.

ex.zh: 我们所有人都祝福你。
ex.p: wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén dōu zhù fú nǐ
ex.en: Best wishes from all of us.

items.en: to bear; to support; to inherit

ex.zh: 这冰太薄不能承受你的重量。
ex.p: zhè bīng tài bó bù néng chéng shòu nǐ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.

ex.zh: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
ex.p: hú shǎng de bīng tài bó le chéng shòu bù le nǐ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.

ex.zh: 妈妈，我肚子饿了。
ex.p: mā ma wǒ dù zi è le
ex.en: Mom, I'm hungry.

ex.zh: 我打了他的肚子。
ex.p: wǒ dá le tā de dù zi
ex.en: I hit him in the belly.

ex.zh: 我们将参加马拉松。
ex.p: wǒ men jiāng cān jiā mǎ lā sōng
ex.en: We'll take part in the marathon.

ex.zh: 说了所有我要说的话后，我感觉很轻松。
ex.p: shuō le suǒ yǒu wǒ yào shuō de huà hòu wǒ gǎn jué hěn qīng sōng
ex.en: I felt quite relieved after I had said all I wanted to say.

items.en: to scale (a height); to ascend; to mount

ex.zh: 那种鞋子用来登山是不行的。
ex.p: nà zhǒng xié zǐ yòng lái dēng shān shì bù xíng de
ex.en: Those shoes won't do for climbing.

ex.zh: 我一直想登富士山。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhí xiǎng dēng fù shì shān
ex.en: I've always wanted to climb Mt. Fuji.

ex.zh: 说实话，这对我来说有点太辣了。
ex.p: shuō shí huà zhè duì wǒ lái shuō yǒu diǎn tài là le
ex.en: To tell you the truth, this is a little too spicy for me.

ex.zh: 辣点儿没关系。
ex.p: là diǎn ér méi guān xi
ex.en: I don't mind if it's hot.

ex.zh: 这些年空气质量恶化了。
ex.p: zhè xiē nián kōng qì zhì liàng è huà le
ex.en: Air quality has deteriorated these past few years.

ex.zh: 这些产品质量同等。
ex.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn zhì liàng tóng děng
ex.en: These products are of the same quality.

items.en: to care about; equivalent of 在于

ex.zh: 她不在乎她的穿著。
ex.p: tā bù zài hu tā de chuān zhù
ex.en: She doesn't care how she dresses.

ex.zh: 我不在乎是否下雪。
ex.p: wǒ bù zài hu shì fǒu xià xuě
ex.en: I don't care if it snows.

ex.zh: 你在车站遇到的男人是我爸。
ex.p: nǐ zài chē zhàn yù dào de nán rén shì wǒ bà
ex.en: The man you met at the station is my father.

ex.zh: 你认为我们会遇到好天气吗？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi wǒ men huì yù dào hǎo tiān qì ma
ex.en: Do you think we'll have good weather?

items.en: to send; to mail; to entrust

ex.zh: 信一写好，他就把它寄了。
ex.p: xìn yī xiě hǎo tā jiù bǎ tā jì le
ex.en: Once he had written the letter, he sent it.

ex.zh: 我会给我的母亲寄封信。
ex.p: wǒ huì gěi wǒ de mǔ qīn jì fēng xìn
ex.en: I'll send my mother a letter.

items.en: to draw (e.g. a bow); to pull; to stretch sth

ex.zh: 检察官问了我一个引导性的问题。
ex.p: jiǎn chá guān wèn le wǒ yī gè yǐn dǎo xìng de wèn tí
ex.en: The prosecutor asked me a leading question.

items.en: to drop; to fall; to come down

ex.zh: 她降低了收音机的音量。
ex.p: tā jiàng dī le shōu yīn jī de yīn liàng
ex.en: She turned down the radio.

ex.zh: 他们正努力降低成本。
ex.p: tā men zhēng nǔ lì jiàng dī chéng běn
ex.en: They're trying to keep costs down.

items.en: to prohibit; to forbid; to ban

ex.zh: 此处禁止停车。
ex.p: cǐ chù jìn zhǐ tíng chē
ex.en: Parking is prohibited here.

ex.zh: 日本米市场禁止进口。
ex.p: rì běn mǐ shì chǎng jìn zhǐ jìn kǒu
ex.en: Japan's rice market is closed to imports.

ex.zh: 我们买了张圆桌。
ex.p: wǒ men mǎi le zhāng yuán zhuō
ex.en: We bought a round table.

ex.zh: 今晚月亮很圆。
ex.p: jīn wǎn yuè liang hěn yuán
ex.en: There's a full moon tonight.

ex.zh: 他睡着的时候，打呼声很响。
ex.p: tā shuì zháo de shí hou dá hū shēng hěn xiǎng
ex.en: He snored loudly while he slept.

ex.zh: 我看书的时候睡着了。
ex.p: wǒ kàn shū de shí hou shuì zháo le
ex.en: I fell asleep while reading.

items.en: to pass; to spend (time); to survive

ex.zh: 这是我度过的最好的夜晚之一。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ dù guò de zuì hǎo de yè wǎn zhī yī
ex.en: It was one of the best nights I've had.

ex.zh: 今晚我度过了一段非常美好的时光。
ex.p: jīn wǎn wǒ dù guò le yī duàn fēi cháng měi hǎo de shí guāng
ex.en: I had a really nice time tonight.

items.en: calm; cool-headed; dispassionate; (of a place) deserted; quiet

ex.zh: 我没办法冷静下来。
ex.p: wǒ méi bàn fǎ lěng jìng xià lai
ex.en: I can't calm down.

ex.zh: 大家需要冷静下来。
ex.p: dà jiā xū yào lěng jìng xià lai
ex.en: Everybody needs to calm down.

ex.zh: 闪电照亮了天空。
ex.p: shǎn diàn zhào liàng le tiān kōng
ex.en: The lightning lit up the sky.

ex.zh: 因为闪光灯坏了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。
ex.p: yīn wèi shǎn guāng dēng huài le tā bù néng zài hēi àn zhōng pāi zhào
ex.en: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.

ex.zh: 他从口袋中拿出了什么。
ex.p: tā cóng kǒu dài zhōng ná chū le shén me
ex.en: He took something out of his pocket.

ex.zh: 这男孩的口袋里有个苹果。
ex.p: zhè nán hái de kǒu dài lǐ yǒu gè píng guǒ
ex.en: The boy has an apple in his pocket.

ex.zh: 我要去购物。你要跟着来吗？
ex.p: wǒ yào qù gòu wù nǐ yào gēn zhe lái ma
ex.en: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?

ex.zh: 什么时候去购物？
ex.p: shén me shí hou qù gòu wù
ex.en: When are we going shopping?

ex.zh: 我觉得她很勇敢。
ex.p: wǒ jué de tā hěn yǒng gǎn
ex.en: I think she is very brave.

ex.zh: 你非常勇敢。
ex.p: nǐ fēi cháng yǒng gǎn
ex.en: You are very brave.

ex.zh: 去公园散步你觉得怎么样？
ex.p: qù gōng yuán sàn bù nǐ jué de zěn me yàng
ex.en: What do you say to taking a walk in the park?

ex.zh: 没有什么比散步更好的了。
ex.p: méi yǒu shén me bǐ sàn bù gēng hǎo de le
ex.en: There's nothing better than taking a nice walk.

items.en: to rely on sth (for support etc); to depend on

ex.zh: 他经济上依靠他的太太。
ex.p: tā jīng jì shǎng yī kào tā de tài tai
ex.en: He relies on his wife financially.

ex.zh: 我的老婆孩子都依靠我。
ex.p: wǒ de lǎo pó hái zi dōu yī kào wǒ
ex.en: My wife and children depend on me.

units.title: 弱、购买、战士
units.intro: HSK 4, words 329–369, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

items.en: weak; feeble; young; inferior; not as good as

ex.zh: 她天生体弱。
ex.p: tā tiān shēng tǐ ruò
ex.en: She's weak by nature.

ex.zh: 谁都有弱点。
ex.p: shéi dōu yǒu ruò diǎn
ex.en: Everybody has weaknesses.

ex.zh: 您现在不必购买任何东西。
ex.p: nín xiàn zài bù bì gòu mǎi rèn hé dōng xī
ex.en: You don't have to buy anything right now.

ex.zh: 我购买一本书花费了三十美元。
ex.p: wǒ gòu mǎi yī běn shū huā fèi le sān shí měi yuán
ex.en: I spent thirty dollars on a book.

ex.zh: 指南针的指针指向北边。
ex.p: zhǐ nán zhēn de zhǐ zhēn zhǐ xiàng běi biān
ex.en: Compass needles point to the north.

ex.zh: 我得给你打一针。
ex.p: wǒ de gěi nǐ dá yī zhēn
ex.en: I need to give you an injection.

ex.zh: 你应该给他看看这装置。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi gěi tā kàn kàn zhè zhuāng zhì
ex.en: You should have shown him the device.

ex.zh: 他们谈计划谈了几个小时。
ex.p: tā men tán jì huà tán le jī gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: They talked over the plan for hours.

ex.zh: 你的计划需要一大笔钱。
ex.p: nǐ de jì huà xū yào yī dà bǐ qián
ex.en: Your plan requires a large amount of money.

items.en: to move; to shift; to change

ex.zh: 许多移民改了名字。
ex.p: xǔ duō yí mín gǎi le míng zi
ex.en: Many of the immigrants changed their names.

ex.zh: 请把桌子向左移。
ex.p: qǐng bǎ zhuō zi xiàng zuǒ yí
ex.en: Please move the desk to the left.

items.en: to survey; to measure; to conjecture

ex.zh: 我们明天有个测验。
ex.p: wǒ men míng tiān yǒu gè cè yàn
ex.en: We have a test tomorrow.

ex.zh: 测速的方法有很多。
ex.p: cè sù de fāng fǎ yǒu hěn duō
ex.en: There are several ways to measure speed.

ex.zh: 她也喜欢巧克力。
ex.p: tā yě xǐ huan qiǎo kè lì
ex.en: She also likes chocolate.

ex.zh: 谁要热巧克力？
ex.p: shéi yào rè qiǎo kè lì
ex.en: Who wants hot chocolate?

items.en: as the time draws near; at the last moment; temporary

ex.zh: 正式工比临时工要好。
ex.p: zhèng shì gōng bǐ lín shí gōng yào hǎo
ex.en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.

items.en: alone; by oneself; on one's own

ex.zh: 我想和汤姆单独谈一谈。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng hé tāng mǔ dān dú tán yī tán
ex.en: I'd like to talk to Tom alone.

items.en: medicine; medical science; study of medicine

ex.zh: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。
ex.p: tā zài yī xué jiè yǒu hěn dà de yǐng xiǎng lì
ex.en: He's very influential in the world of medicine.

ex.zh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ suǒ jiàn guò de zuì dà xíng de gòu zào le
ex.en: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.

items.en: to reduce; to lower; to bring down

ex.zh: 她降低了收音机的音量。
ex.p: tā jiàng dī le shōu yīn jī de yīn liàng
ex.en: She turned down the radio.

ex.zh: 他们正努力降低成本。
ex.p: tā men zhēng nǔ lì jiàng dī chéng běn
ex.en: They're trying to keep costs down.

items.en: to brush; to paint; to daub

ex.zh: 他把他的自行车刷成红色。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā de zì xíng chē shuā chéng hóng sè
ex.en: He painted his bicycle red.

ex.zh: 他把天花板刷成了蓝色。
ex.p: tā bǎ tiān huā bǎn shuā chéng le lán sè
ex.en: He painted the ceiling blue.

items.en: to put out; to come up with; to draw (conclusion)

ex.zh: 你怎样作出的解释？
ex.p: nǐ zěn yàng zuò chū de jiě shì
ex.en: How do you account for that?

ex.zh: 留下来和我们一起喝酒吧。
ex.p: liú xià lái hé wǒ men yī qǐ hē jiǔ bā
ex.en: Stay and have a drink with us.

ex.zh: 他是这里附近酒吧和酒馆的常客。
ex.p: tā shì zhè lǐ fù jìn jiǔ bā hé jiǔ guǎn de cháng kè
ex.en: He's a regular at the bars and pubs around here.

items.en: (of competition or fighting) intense; fierce; (of pain) acute
to miss; to remember with longing; to long to see again

ex.zh: 妈妈想念她在读大学的女儿。
ex.p: mā ma xiǎng niàn tā zài dòu dà xué de nǚ ér
ex.en: The mother missed her daughter who was away at college.

ex.zh: 我昨天非常想念你。
ex.p: wǒ zuó tiān fēi cháng xiǎng niàn nǐ
ex.en: I missed you very much yesterday.

ex.zh: 他预测会下雨。
ex.p: tā yù cè huì xià yǔ
ex.en: He predicted there would be rain.

items.en: to fix; to fasten; to set rigidly in place

ex.zh: 你有一个固定的男朋友吗？
ex.p: nǐ yǒu yī gè gù dìng de nán péng you ma
ex.en: Do you have a steady boyfriend?

ex.zh: 我在找一些固定工作。
ex.p: wǒ zài zhǎo yī xiē gù dìng gōng zuò
ex.en: I'm looking for some regular work.

ex.zh: 士兵们失去了战斗的勇气。
ex.p: shì bīng men shī qù le zhàn dòu de yǒng qì
ex.en: The soldiers lost the courage to fight.

items.en: to be located at; to be situated at; to lie

ex.zh: 教堂位于山脚。
ex.p: jiào táng wèi yú shān jiǎo
ex.en: The church is at the foot of a mountain.

ex.zh: 图书馆位于城市中心。
ex.p: tú shū guǎn wèi yú chéng shì zhōng xīn
ex.en: The library is in the center of the city.

ex.zh: 宝宝在摇篮里入睡了。
ex.p: bǎo bao zài yáo lán lǐ rù shuì le
ex.en: The baby fell asleep in the cradle.

ex.zh: 我们毫不费力地想出了密码。
ex.p: wǒ men háo bù fèi lì de xiǎng chū le mì mǎ
ex.en: We easily figured out the password.

items.en: to cultivate; to breed; to foster

ex.zh: 培养政治意识要花费时间。
ex.p: péi yǎng zhèng zhì yì shí yào huā fèi shí jiān
ex.en: Developing political awareness takes time.

ex.zh: 暴风雨后，大海恢复了平静。
ex.p: bào fēng yǔ hòu dà hǎi huī fù le píng jìng
ex.en: After the storm, the sea was quiet again.

items.en: to defend; to safeguard; to protect

ex.zh: 无数星星在天上闪烁。
ex.p: wú shù xīng xing zài tiān shàng shǎn shuò
ex.en: Countless stars were twinkling in the sky.

items.en: to handle; to deal with; to tackle; to get by with; to make do

ex.zh: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。
ex.p: rú guǒ bì yào de huà wǒ bù fǎn duì fù tè bié fèi yòng
ex.en: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.

items.en: to close; to shut (a window etc); (of a shop, school etc) to shut down

ex.zh: 请关闭电视机。
ex.p: qǐng guān bì diàn shì jī
ex.en: Please turn off the TV.

ex.zh: 关闭电视机
ex.p: guān bì diàn shì jī
ex.en: Turn off the TV.

ex.zh: 我一直想成为一名职业篮球运动员。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhí xiǎng chéng wéi yī míng zhí yè lán qiú yùn dòng yuán
ex.en: I've always wanted to be a professional basketball player.

ex.zh: 我有一个兄弟和两个姐妹。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu yī gè xiōng dì hé liǎng gè jiě mèi
ex.en: I have one brother and two sisters.

ex.zh: 我有两个兄弟和三个姐妹。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu liǎng gè xiōng dì hé sān gè jiě mèi

ex.zh: 航空邮寄它。

ex.en: Send it airmail.

ex.zh: 她需要一件外套。
ex.p: tā xū yào yī jiàn wài tào
ex.en: She needs a coat.

ex.zh: 我也想要和你身上那件同样的外套。
ex.p: wǒ yě xiǎng yào hé nǐ shēn shang nà jiàn tóng yàng de wài tào
ex.en: I want the same jacket as you're wearing.

ex.zh: 我们希望你来我们的聚会。
ex.p: wǒ men xī wàng nǐ lái wǒ men de jù huì
ex.en: We would like you to come to our party.

ex.zh: 我听到聚会的事很高兴。
ex.p: wǒ tīng dào jù huì de shì hěn gāo xìng
ex.en: I'm very happy to hear about the party.

items.en: to exchange; to swap; to switch (telecom)
to congregate; to assemble; to mass

ex.zh: 我们每周在这儿聚一次。
ex.p: wǒ men měi zhōu zài zhèr jù yī cì
ex.en: We meet here once a week.

ex.zh: 会不会只有我一个人去聚会？
ex.p: huì bù huì zhǐ yǒu wǒ yī gè rén qù jù huì
ex.en: Will I be the only one going to the party?

ex.zh: 我害怕一个人处在黑暗之中。
ex.p: wǒ hài pà yī gè rén chǔ zài hēi àn zhī zhōng
ex.en: I was scared to be alone in the dark.

ex.zh: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。
ex.p: wǒ men de yǎn jing xū yào shí jiān lái shì yìng hēi àn
ex.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the dark.

ex.zh: 你运气多好啊！
ex.p: nǐ yùn qi duō hǎo a
ex.en: How lucky you are!

ex.zh: 您运气多好啊！
ex.p: nín yùn qi duō hǎo a
ex.en: How lucky you are!

items.en: to keep in the mouth; to contain

ex.zh: 我妈妈眼含着泪看我。
ex.p: wǒ mā ma yǎn hán zhe lèi kàn wǒ
ex.en: My mother looked at me with tears in her eyes.

ex.zh: 这个词有两种含义。
ex.p: zhè gè cí yǒu liǎng zhǒng hán yì
ex.en: This word has two meanings.

ex.zh: 这是典型的。
ex.p: zhè shì diǎn xíng de
ex.en: This is typical.

ex.zh: 他们是典型的年轻人。
ex.p: tā men shì diǎn xíng de nián qīng rén
ex.en: They're typical youngsters.

ex.zh: 这对夫妇生了个儿子。
ex.p: zhè duì fū fù shēng le gèr zǐ
ex.en: The couple had a son.

items.en: to provide guidance; to lecture sb; to upbraid

ex.zh: 记好了这教训。
ex.p: jì hǎo le zhè jiào xun
ex.en: Keep this lesson in mind.

ex.zh: 汤姆给自己浇凉水以清醒过来。
ex.p: tāng mǔ gěi zì jǐ jiāo liáng shuǐ yǐ qīng xǐng guò lái
ex.en: Tom poured cold water over himself to wake himself up.

items.en: in a word; in short; in brief

ex.zh: 我们看见地面被雪覆盖了。
ex.p: wǒ men kàn jiàn dì miàn bèi xuě fù gài le
ex.en: We saw the ground covered with snow.

ex.zh: 纯真是一件美好的事。
ex.p: chún zhēn shì yī jiàn měi hǎo de shì
ex.en: Innocence is a beautiful thing.

ex.zh: 样本不够纯净。
ex.p: yàng běn bù gòu chún jìng
ex.en: The sample isn't pure enough.

ex.zh: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。
ex.p: tā mài zhe wěn jiàn de bù fá dēng shǎng le shān qiū
ex.en: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.

items.en: to unify; to integrate; unified; integrated

ex.zh: 这套房子设施便利齐全。
ex.p: zhè tào fáng zi shè shī biàn lì qí quán
ex.en: The house has all the conveniences.

ex.zh: 我腰疼，不能打网球。
ex.p: wǒ yāo téng bù néng dá wǎng qiú
ex.en: I can't play tennis because my back hurts.

ex.zh: 这是您的义务。
ex.p: zhè shì nín de yì wù
ex.en: That's your responsibility.

items.en: to use; to put to use

ex.zh: 在她的帮助下，我的法语逐渐进步了。
ex.p: zài tā de bāng zhù xià wǒ de fǎ yǔ zhú jiàn jìn bù le
ex.en: With her help, my French improved little by little.

ex.zh: 我全身酸痛。
ex.p: wǒ quán shēn suān tòng
ex.en: I ache all over.

ex.zh: 第二天我的腿很酸。
ex.p: dì èr tiān wǒ de tuǐ hěn suān
ex.en: I had sore legs the next day.

ex.zh: 她一整天都沉默不语。
ex.p: tā yī zhěng tiān dōu chén mò bù yǔ
ex.en: She remained silent all day.

ex.zh: 开口是银，沉默是金。
ex.p: kāi kǒu shì yín chén mò shì jīn
ex.en: Speech is silver, silence is gold.

ex.zh: 我遇见了一位老妇人。
ex.p: wǒ yù jiàn le yī wèi lǎo fù rén
ex.en: I met an old woman.

ex.zh: 我遇见一个朋友。
ex.p: wǒ yù jiàn yī gè péng you
ex.en: I met a friend.

items.en: to snap; to break (a stick, a bone etc); to sustain a loss (in business)

ex.zh: 这个男孩把收音机折散架了。
ex.p: zhè gè nán hái bǎ shōu yīn jī shé sàn jià le
ex.en: The boy took the radio apart.

ex.zh: 你能不能给我打折？
ex.p: nǐ néng bù néng gěi wǒ dǎ zhé
ex.en: Can you give me a discount?

items.en: to break away from; to cast off (old ideas etc); to get rid of

ex.zh: 我要摆脱这一切。
ex.p: wǒ yào bǎi tuō zhè yī qiè
ex.en: I'm going to get rid of all this stuff.

ex.zh: 我已经头疼三天了，还没摆脱它。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng tóu téng sān tiān le hái méi bǎi tuō tā
ex.en: I've had a headache for three days and I can't get rid of it.

ex.zh: 健康比财富重要。
ex.p: jiàn kāng bǐ cái fù zhòng yào
ex.en: Health is above wealth.

ex.zh: 健康胜于财富。
ex.p: jiàn kāng shèng yú cái fù
ex.en: Health is above wealth.

ex.zh: 眼泪顺着她的脸颊流下来。
ex.p: yǎn lèi shùn zhe tā de liǎn jiá liú xià lai
ex.en: Tears were flowing down her cheeks.

ex.zh: 由于噪音，我无法集中精力工作了。
ex.p: yóu yú zào yīn wǒ wú fǎ jí zhōng jīng lì gōng zuò le
ex.en: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.

items.en: to separate; to partition; to stand or lie between

ex.zh: 他们之间隔着很远的距离。
ex.p: tā men zhī jiān gé zhe hěn yuǎn de jù lí
ex.en: They are separated by a great distance.

ex.zh: 我的家与他的隔着一条江。
ex.p: wǒ de jiā yú tā de gé zhe yī tiáo jiāng
ex.en: My home is separated from his by a river.

ex.zh: 我新家的客厅很宽敞。
ex.p: wǒ xīn jiā de kè tīng hěn kuān chang
ex.en: The living room in my new house is very large.

items.en: statistics; to count; to add up

ex.zh: 事实是倔强的，但统计是柔顺的。
ex.p: shì shí shì jué jiàng de dàn tǒng jì shì róu shùn de
ex.en: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.

ex.zh: 他的叔叔五年前去世了。
ex.p: tā de shū shu wǔ nián qián qù shì le
ex.en: His uncle died five years ago.

ex.zh: 你叔叔让你开他的车了吗？
ex.p: nǐ shū shu ràng nǐ kāi tā de chē le ma
ex.en: Did your uncle let you drive his car?

items.en: average; on average; evenly; in equal proportions

ex.zh: 选手们的平均身高是多少？
ex.p: xuǎn shǒu men de píng jūn shēn gāo shì duō shǎo
ex.en: What's the average height of the players?

items.en: to supply; to provide; to offer

ex.zh: 我会给你你想要的任何事物。
ex.p: wǒ huì gěi nǐ nǐ xiǎng yào de rèn hé shì wù
ex.en: I'll give you whatever you want.

ex.zh: 人们通常不喜欢他们不理解的事物。
ex.p: rén men tōng cháng bù xǐ huan tā men bù lǐ xiè de shì wù
ex.en: People usually don't like what they don't understand.

ex.zh: 他做的和我要求的相反。
ex.p: tā zuò de hé wǒ yāo qiú de xiāng fǎn
ex.en: He did the reverse of what I asked.

ex.zh: 我没有抓到他演讲的重点。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu zhuā dào tā yǎn jiǎng de chóng diǎn
ex.en: I didn't get the point of his speech.

ex.zh: 我没有一次演讲的时候是不紧张的。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī cì yǎn jiǎng de shí hou shì bù jǐn zhāng de
ex.en: I never make a speech without being nervous.

units.intro: HSK 4, words 411–451, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.zh: 她戴上了帽子准备出去。
ex.p: tā dài shǎng le mào zi zhǔn bèi chū qù
ex.en: She put on her hat to go out.

ex.zh: 这顶红帽子很衬她的裙子。
ex.p: zhè dǐng hóng mào zi hěn chèn tā de qún zi
ex.en: The red hat goes well with her dress.

items.en: to bear (an expense, a responsibility etc); burden

ex.zh: 我负担不起。
ex.p: wǒ fù dān bù qǐ
ex.en: I can't afford it.

items.en: to prevail over; to defeat; to surmount

ex.zh: 你太过分了。
ex.p: nǐ tài guò fèn le
ex.en: You've overdone it.

ex.zh: 我不是有意要保密的。
ex.p: wǒ bù shì yǒu yì yào bǎo mì de
ex.en: I didn't mean to keep it secret.

ex.zh: 我知道你所有的秘密。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào nǐ suǒ yǒu de mì mì
ex.en: I know all your secrets.

ex.zh: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。
ex.p: zài xīn jiā pō de jiē dào shǎng rēng lā jī huì bèi fá kuǎn
ex.en: They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.

items.en: to cultivate; to train; to groom

ex.zh: 他够大了，可以独自旅行了。
ex.p: tā gòu dà le kě yǐ dú zì lǚ xíng le
ex.en: He is old enough to travel alone.

ex.zh: 她把她儿子独自留在了车里。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā ér zi dú zì liú zài le chē lǐ
ex.en: She left her son alone in the car.

items.en: to expand; to enlarge; to broaden one's scope

ex.zh: 他把奖金存到银行了。
ex.p: tā bǎ jiǎng jīn cún dào yín háng le
ex.en: He deposited the prize money in the bank.

ex.zh: 她发现她已经断盐了。
ex.p: tā fā xiàn tā yǐ jīng duàn yán le
ex.en: She discovered that she had run out of salt.

ex.zh: 我们该不该再加点盐？
ex.p: wǒ men gāi bù gāi zài jiā diǎn yán
ex.en: Should we add a little more salt?

ex.zh: 我只是个大众脸。
ex.p: wǒ zhǐ shì gè dà zhòng liǎn
ex.en: I'm just another man.

ex.zh: 因为堵车，我开会迟到了。
ex.p: yīn wèi dǔ chē wǒ kāi huì chí dào le
ex.en: Because there was traffic, I was late to the meeting.

ex.zh: 睡过头不是迟到的理由。
ex.p: shuì guò tóu bù shì chí dào de lǐ yóu
ex.en: Over-sleeping is no excuse for being late.

items.en: to cherish the memory of; to think of; to reminisce

ex.zh: 想象一下，假如你有一台时光机。
ex.p: xiǎng xiàng yī xià jiǎ rú nǐ yǒu yī tái shí guāng jī
ex.en: Imagine that you have a time machine.

ex.zh: 我想改善我的英语发音。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng gǎi shàn wǒ de yīng yǔ fā yīn
ex.en: I would like to improve my English pronunciation.

ex.zh: 有很多的方法可以改善人的一生。
ex.p: yǒu hěn duō de fāng fǎ kě yǐ gǎi shàn rén de yī shēng
ex.en: There are many ways to improve one's life.

ex.zh: 我不想晒黑。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng shài hēi
ex.en: I don't want to get a suntan.

items.en: to lower; to decrease; to reduce

ex.zh: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。
ex.p: zhè zhǒng yào huì jiǎn qīng nǐ de téng tòng
ex.en: This medicine will decrease your pain.

ex.zh: 八减去三就能得到五。
ex.p: bā jiǎn qù sān jiù néng dé dào wǔ
ex.en: Subtract three from eight and you get five.

items.en: government; official (approved or issued by an authority)

ex.zh: 这是官方消息。
ex.p: zhè shì guān fāng xiāo xi
ex.en: This news is official.

items.en: to guide; to lead (around); to conduct

ex.zh: 我们的航班被取消了。
ex.p: wǒ men de háng bān bèi qǔ xiāo le
ex.en: Our flight was canceled.

ex.zh: 我的航班晚点了。
ex.p: wǒ de háng bān wǎn diǎn le
ex.en: My flight was delayed.

ex.zh: 我父母不让我和男生约会。
ex.p: wǒ fù mǔ bù ràng wǒ hé nán shēng yuē huì
ex.en: My parents won't let me date.

ex.zh: 你觉得我明天约会穿什么好呢？
ex.p: nǐ jué de wǒ míng tiān yuē huì chuān shén me hǎo ne
ex.en: What do you think I should wear on my date tomorrow?

ex.zh: 我爸爸会在这周末回家。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba huì zài zhè zhōu mò huí jiā
ex.en: My father will come home at the end of this week.

ex.zh: 我每个周末早上工作三小时。
ex.p: wǒ měi gè zhōu mò zǎo shang gōng zuò sān xiǎo shí
ex.en: I work for three hours every Sunday morning.

ex.zh: 形势似乎非常紧张严峻。
ex.p: xíng shì sì hū fēi cháng jǐn zhāng yán jùn
ex.en: The situation seemed very tense and dangerous.

items.en: thin or slender; finely particulate; thin and soft

ex.zh: 她仔细考虑了他的提议。
ex.p: tā zǐ xì kǎo lǜ le tā de tí yì
ex.en: She considered his offer carefully.

items.en: unbearable; unable to endure; can't stand

ex.zh: 我真的受不了了。
ex.p: wǒ zhēn de shòu bù liǎo le
ex.en: I just can't take it anymore.

ex.zh: 我受不了他。
ex.p: wǒ shòu bù liǎo tā
ex.en: I can't stand him.

items.en: to sell; to offer for sale; to put on the market

ex.zh: 这房子不出售。
ex.p: zhè fáng zi bù chū shòu
ex.en: This house isn't for sale.

ex.zh: 事故似乎和厚厚的积雪有关。
ex.p: shì gù sì hū hé hòu hòu de jī xuě yǒu guān
ex.en: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.

ex.zh: 冰厚得足以让我在上面走路。
ex.p: bīng hòu de zú yǐ ràng wǒ zài shàng miàn zǒu lù
ex.en: The ice was thick enough for me to walk on.

items.en: to toughen; to temper; to engage in physical exercise

ex.zh: 我需要更经常地锻炼。
ex.p: wǒ xū yào gēng jīng cháng de duàn liàn
ex.en: I need to exercise more often.

items.en: to block up (a road, pipe etc); to stop up (a hole); wall (literary)

ex.zh: 因为堵车，我开会迟到了。
